terminal_station.name: 旧コマ劇場の採用入口前
terminal_station.framing_choice: Stand back in the adopted entrance forecourt so the Koma name, canopy, doors and threshold share a 35 mm frame; avoid a dark glass close-up.
terminal_station.entry_behavior: Stop outside the physical threshold steps; do not enter the auditorium.
terminal_station.position_status: Adopted from the inferred western frontage and entrance fraction, not a surveyed 1976 entrance.

motion_plan.position_method: R01 station polyline plus the adopted Koma entrance forecourt stop, split at source TIN edges and refined to 0.25 m 3D spacing
motion_plan.orientation_method: Initial gaze at the adopted gate plate eases down to street level over 16 m; 1.5 m fore/aft tangent window inside each moving leg; stationary eased pans at sharp turns and arrival
motion_plan.timing_method: constant acceleration to 1 m/s, cruise, constant deceleration to rest before stationary pans
motion_plan.playback: Positions and quaternions are key samples. Interpolate position by the stated arc-distance speed profile, terrain height by the TIN, and orientation with shortest-path quaternion interpolation.
